newsitem.title: USA: 3DO to sell Samsung its hardware business.
newsitem.headline: 3DO to sell Samsung its hardware business.

text.p: 3DO Co said on Monday it executed a definitive agreement for Samsung Electronics Co Ltd to buy 3DO's hardware systems business for $20 million in cash.
The company said Trip Hawkins would have complete operating control of the new software-focused 3DO, as chairman, chief executive officer and president.

Samsung would form a new company based in Silicon Valley focusing on multimedia systems and semiconductor products, 3DO said. About 75 3DO employees in its hardware systems business would be offered jobs in the new company, it said.
Tobin Farrand, 3DO's senior vice president of engineering, would become president and CEO of the new Samsung unit, the company said.
Hugh Martin, who has been president and chief operating officer of 3DO, would oversee the transition of business to Samsung and phase out of his daily duties, 3DO said.
He would remain on the company's board, it said.
The deal would close as soon as Korean and U.S. government approvals were obtained, the company said.
